title: CastFlow: Bridging Evidence Acquisition and Accurate Prediction in Agentic Time Series Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2604.27840v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Time series forecasting is a fundamental task in temporal data analytics, and large language model (LLM)-based agents offer a promising paradigm through autonomous tool interaction and evidence-grounded reasoning. However, two fundamental challenges remain: how to acquire forecast-relevant evidence through adaptive tool interactions, and how to translate such evidence into accurate numerical predictions. To address these challenges, we propose CastFlow, a role-specialized agentic forecasting framework that bridges general-purpose tool reasoning and specialized temporal forecasting. Specifically, CastFlow introduces an Experience Memory that distills successful tool-use trajectories from training data, guiding a frozen LLM to orchestrate a multi-view toolkit for evidence acquisition. translated_title: CastFlow：在智能体时间序列预测中架起证据获取与准确预测之间的桥梁
translated_abstract: 时间序列预测是时序数据分析中的一项基础任务，而基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体通过自主工具交互和基于证据的推理提供了一种有前景的范式。然而，仍存在两个根本性挑战：如何通过自适应的工具交互获取与预测相关的证据，以及如何将此类证据转化为准确的数值预测。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了CastFlow，这是一个角色专门化的智能体预测框架，连接了通用工具推理与专门化的时间序列预测。具体而言，CastFlow引入了一个经验记忆模块，从训练数据中提炼成功的工具使用轨迹，指导冻结的LLM调度多视角工具包以完成证据获取。随后，一个轻量级的专门化LLM执行基于证据的时间推理，以细化集成预测先验。为增强这一能力……
tldr: CastFlow提出了一种角色专门化的智能体时间序列预测框架，通过经验记忆引导冻结的大语言模型调度多视角工具获取证据，再由轻量级专门化模型进行基于证据的时间推理，从而有效衔接证据获取与准确的数值预测。
en_tdlr: CastFlow is a role-specialized agentic forecasting framework that uses an Experience Memory to guide a frozen LLM in orchestrating a multi-view toolkit for evidence acquisition, while a lightweight specialized LLM performs evidence-grounded temporal reasoning to translate evidence into accurate numerical forecasts.
